node.content-desc:
Investigative journalist Ravi Nair is reportedly lodged in Ahmedabad Central Jail in Gujarat since Thursday (September 17).
In a plea in the Gujarat high court, Nair has submitted that a Gandhinagar court, which had issued a non-bailable warrant against him earlier this month in a criminal defamation case files by Adani Enterprises, had done so without issuing any formal summons or notice.
The high court reportedly issued notices to the Gujarat government and Adani Enterprises on Saturday, meaning that they were supposed to respond by the next hearing, held on September 21. However, the Indian Express reports that senior counsel appearing for Adani Enterprises sought time to place “certain legal and factual aspects” on record and did not file their response.
Justice M.K. Thakker on Monday adjourned Nair’s hearing until Wednesday (September 23), the new date by when the Gujarat government and Adani Enterprises are expected to file their affidavits.
